answer: Bind each identity to one carrier-verified phone number. First, the agent submits a number and enters a one-time SMS code. Second, the carrier confirms it is a real ID-registered SIM, not a hollow VoIP shell, and locks it to one key for 90 days. Third, each epoch the agent re-confirms it; a lapsed number, or one under a second key, loses standing at once. Forging 1,000 agents needs 1,000 SIMs at $10 each plus 15 minutes activation each: $10,000 and 250 hours. One number per agent is like one flag per knoll: a second flag there is obvious, and a fake inlet leads no ship to harbor.
